items.title: M(h)aol – “Scam Manifesto”
items.summary: Irish post-punkers M(h)aol signed to Merge and released their album Something Soft last year. Since then, they've lost a member and become a trio, and now they've shared the jittery, deadpan new one-off single "Scam Manifesto." (Anyone who saw I Shot Andy Warhol will be able to appreciate the wordplay of that title.) It's about the way you can feel about yourself after too much time on the internet: "I said that I’m worth more, but I’m a liar/ I see my limbs and all I want to do is set my house on fire." Former member Sarah Deegan, now of Pixie Cut Rhythm Orchestra, joins in on backup vocals.

items.title: Cassandra Wilson, Grammy-winning jazz singer, dies aged 70
items.summary: Mississippi-born Wilson, who worked across folk, pop, R&B and country, was once dubbed America’s best singer Cassandra Wilson, the two-time Grammy-winning jazz singer, songwriter and producer has died. She was 70. Dubbed America’s best singer by Time magazine in 2001, Wilson was best known for her genre-bending voice, which expanded the boundaries of traditional blues-based jazz and worked effortlessly across folk, pop, R&B, country and beyond. At the heart of all her work was her idiosyncratic contralto, a soulful sound distinctly tied to her roots. Continue reading...
